name: World Gym Corporation
summary: World Gym Corporation primarily operates within the health, fitness, and recreational sports industry, encompassing sauna facilities, across both Taiwan and the United States. Its activities extend to overseeing leisure sports and fitness centers and delivering a comprehensive range of related physical fitness services. Furthermore, the company manages and licenses intellectual property associated with various fitness brands. Established in 1976, its corporate headquarters are located in Taichung, Taiwan. The entity previously operated as World Fitness Services Ltd., officially adopting its current name, World Gym Corporation, in May 2025.
